description:
**Job Description**
**About the Role**
As Jefferies transitions from traditional SaaS workflows to an Agentic AI Operating Model, the skillsets required to manage the platform shift fundamentally. The platform relies on continuous monitoring, external signal processing (Watcher Agents), and Human-in-the-Loop (HITL) governance.
  
  
We are seeking a hybrid engineering profile—a Lead AI Engineer—who bridges the gap between enterprise systems integration, LLM prompt governance, and complex business logic. This role goes beyond traditional "keep the lights on" IT support; this individual will act as the operational pilot of the AI platform, tuning agent behavior, ensuring data security, and evolving the system's capabilities to meet dynamic business demands.
  
  
You will be the primary technical owner of the platform: operating and hardening it in production, extending its AI agent workflows and enterprise integrations, and driving the Phase 2 roadmap (candidate portal, scheduling, assessments, and further automation).
  
  
**Technology Stack**

* Frontend: React 19, TypeScript, Vite, Tailwind CSS, React Router
* Backend: Python 3.12+, FastAPI, Pydantic, async I/O, Server-Sent Events (SSE)
* AI / Agents: LangGraph and LangChain agent pipelines with AWS-hosted LLMs (e.g., Amazon Bedrock), human-in-the-loop approval gates, agent control room, prompt and eval management
* Database: MongoDB / Amazon DocumentDB (document modeling, async access via Motor)
* Cloud & DevOps: AWS, Docker, Infrastructure as Code, CI/CD, structured logging, metrics, tracing, audit trails
* Enterprise integrations: Oracle ORC (HRIS — requisitions, candidates, scorecards), PeopleSoft incl. CSS (staffing & comp), background-check vendor APIs (e.g., First Advantage — bidirectional), DocuSign e-signature, Microsoft Exchange / Outlook via Graph API, ServiceNow ITSM
* Sourcing channel integrations: LinkedIn Recruiter System Connect (One-Click Export ingest), Indeed Retrieve Candidates API (GraphQL + OAuth), Naukri ATS webhook ingest

**Key Responsibilities**

* Own production operations of the platform: monitoring, incident response, root-cause analysis, patching, upgrades, and SLA adherence (“keep the lights on”).
* Evolve the platform on the delivered foundation: design, build, and ship new features across the React frontend and FastAPI backend.
* Maintain and extend agentic AI workflows — agent nodes, prompts, guardrails, tool bindings, and human-in-the-loop approval gates — including evaluation and bias-governance of AI scoring.
* Operate and extend the connector framework integrating Oracle ORC, PeopleSoft, BGC vendors, DocuSign, Exchange/O365, and ServiceNow.
* Maintain sourcing-channel ingestion pipelines — LinkedIn RSC candidate export, Indeed Retrieve Candidates API streaming, and Naukri webhook receivers — feeding the Sourcing Agent's scoring and shortlisting.
* Manage data models and pipelines in MongoDB/DocumentDB, ensuring data quality, sync integrity across systems of record, and auditability.
* Own the AWS infrastructure via IaC and CI/CD; manage environments, releases, security posture (SSO/RBAC), and cost.
* Maintain observability: dashboards, agent audit trails, structured logs, alerts, and operational runbooks.
* Partner with HR Ops, Recruiting, Legal/Compliance, and IT stakeholders to prioritize the backlog and translate business needs into platform capabilities.
* Agent Operations: Monitor, tune, and deploy updates to specialized AI process agents (e.g., automated sourcing, offer generation, candidate triage) utilizing Jefferies' internal LLM gateways.
* Ontology & Knowledge Base Maintenance: Continuously update the system’s Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) knowledge graph (e.g., uploading new compliance policies, visa regulations, or compensation matrices) to ensure agents reason against the latest ground-truth data.
* Data Sovereignty & PII Handling: Proven ability to architect data-masking pipelines to ensure highly sensitive data (Compensation, SSNs, Diversity metrics) is encrypted, scrubbed, and strictly isolated from broader LLM reasoning engines.
* Algorithmic Bias & Regulatory Auditing: Familiarity with validating AI outputs against strict employment and compliance laws (e.g., EEOC guidelines, NY Fair Chance Act constraints) to ensure automated workflows remain legally defensible and auditable.
* Lead knowledge transfer from the delivery partner and serve as the internal technical authority for the platform.

**Required Skills & Experience Skill AreaWhat We Expect**
Full-stack engineering Strong professional software engineering experience, with ownership of production systems
  
  
Python backend (FastAPI) Async Python services, REST APIs, Pydantic data modeling, SSE/streaming patterns
  
  
React / TypeScript Modern React (hooks, router), TypeScript, Vite, Tailwind CSS; component-driven UI

description:
**ZS**
is a place where passion changes lives. As a management consulting and technology firm focused on improving life and how we live it, we transform ideas into impact by
**bringing together data, science, technology**
and
**human ingenuity**
to deliver better outcomes for all. Here you’ll work side-by-side with a powerful collective of thinkers and experts shaping life-changing solutions for patients, caregivers and consumers, worldwide. ZSers drive impact by bringing a
**client-first mentality**
to each and every engagement. We partner collaboratively with our clients to develop custom solutions and technology products that create value and deliver company results across critical areas of their business. Bring your curiosity for learning, bold ideas, courage and passion to drive life-changing impact to ZS.
  
  
**Insights & Analytics**
**ZS's Insights & Analytics group**
partners with clients to design and deliver solutions to help them tackle a broad range of business challenges. Our teams work on multiple projects simultaneously, leveraging advanced data analytics and problem-solving techniques. Our recommendations and solutions are based on rigorous research and analysis underpinned by deep expertise and thought leadership.
  
  
**The role**
A build-and-advise role. You lead build pods on AI-enabled analytics products and independently own core commercial analytics problems for the same client teams. Expect roughly a 60/40 split between AI engineering and core analytics, flexing with the release cycle. You own workstream-level delivery, manage 2–4 Associates / Associate Consultants, and are the day-to-day technical counterpart for client analytics and enterprise-AI stakeholders.
  
  
This is not a pure AI/ML engineering role. When build demand is low, you are staffed on core analytics workstreams for the same client; when it is high, you lead the build. Both halves are required.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**

* AI & analytics engineering (~60%)

+ Own end-to-end build of insight pipelines on Databricks: certified Delta tables → metric layer → signal detection → LLM narrative → application surface.
+ Design agentic workflows on an agent SDK (Claude Agent SDK or equivalent): tool design, context and prompt engineering, governed context stores, fallbacks and failure handling.
+ Enforce guardrails in data and metadata — governed tables, SQL-level scope control — rather than in prompt instructions.
+ Build evaluation harnesses for LLM output: answer-quality rubrics, binary gates (numerical fidelity, grounding, compliance), regression suites, release gates; tracing via Langfuse/LangSmith or equivalent.
+ Deliver conversational analytics (NL-to-SQL) on governed semantic layers (Databricks Genie, Metric Views) with certified KPI definitions.
+ Set engineering standards: code review, Git/CI, unit and SIT test plans, UAT support, release notes, observability, cost and latency tracking.
+ Produce architecture documents, security / IT-risk evidence packs and status reporting with honest status legends (implemented / in-flight / planned / blocked).

**Core commercial analytics (~40%)**

* Take ambiguous questions from any client function — commercial, medical, market access, clinical development, supply chain, enterprise operations — and structure them into decision-oriented analytical plans; own them end to end.
* Pick the method the question needs — diagnostic analysis, cohort and longitudinal analysis, segmentation, forecasting, test-and-control and causal inference, predictive modelling, optimisation — and defend the choice.
* Work across the client's data estate — syndicated and patient-level real-world data, clinical and trial data, engagement and CRM data, payer and access data, operational and financial data — integrating sources and resolving definitional conflicts.
* Establish governed definitions (KPIs, cohorts, business rules) with the client and make them enforceable in code — one definition, every surface.
* Convert results into decisions: QC'd, client-ready narratives and decks; activation into workflows, dashboards or products; present to Director+ stakeholders.

**Client & team leadership**

* Plan, review and coach a team of 2–4; QC everything before it reaches the client.
* Own workstream status, risks and dependencies with ZS leadership and client PMO.
* Contribute to proposals, POVs and CST capability building — reusable assets and AI upskilling of CST talent.

**What You’ll Bring**

* A bachelor’s or master’s degree in engineering (any discipline) with strong academic performance, particularly in analytics and quantitative coursework
* 5 – 8 years of relevant job experience. An MBA/PhD may substitute in lieu of work experience
* SQL — expert. Window functions, cohort and longitudinal logic, performance tuning on claims-scale data.
* Python — production-grade. pandas/PySpark, packaging, testing, Git; you have owned code others depend on.
* Lakehouse platform — Databricks (Delta, Unity Catalog, Spark, Workflows) or comparable (Snowflake/BigQuery + Spark).
* LLM application engineering — Prompt and context engineering, RAG, function/tool calling, agent frameworks (Claude Agent SDK, LangGraph or equivalent), evaluation and monitoring. You can explain how your system failed and what you changed.
* Applied analytics — solving business problems in a stakeholder-facing role, spanning more than one method family: diagnostic and cohort/longitudinal analysis, segmentation, test-and-control / causal inference, forecasting, predictive modelling; statistical rigour and explicit QC. Life-sciences or healthcare analytics experience strongly preferred — any function (commercial, medical, market access, clinical development, operations); hands-on with real-world data (claims, EHR, registries), clinical/trial or engagement data a plus.
* Consulting skills. Structure ambiguity, own deliverables end to end, communicate crisply in PowerPoint, Excel and in the room.
* People leadership. Has led 2+ people on delivery with accountability for their output quality.
* Fluency in English
* Client-first mentality
* Intense work ethic
* Collaborative spirit and problem-solving approach

**How you’ll grow:**

* Cross-functional skills development & custom learning pathways
* Milestone training programs aligned to career progression opportunities
* Internal mobility paths that empower growth via s-curves, individual contribution and role expansions

**Perks & Benefits:**
At ZS, your growth matters. We offer a comprehensive total rewards package that supports your health and well‑being, financial future, time away, and professional development. With robust skills‑building programs, multiple career progression paths, internal mobility, and a deeply collaborative culture, you’ll have the opportunity to do meaningful work, expand your capabilities, and thrive as part of a global community. For details on total rewards in India, visit ZS India office locations | Where we work | ZS.
  
  
**Hybrid working model:**
We are committed to giving our employees a flexible and connected way of working. A flexible and connected ZS allows us to combine work from home and on-site presence at clients/ZS offices for the majority of our week. The magic of ZS culture and innovation thrives in both planned and spontaneous face-to-face connections.
  
  
**Travel:**

title: Supply Chain Analyst
description:
**Life tastes better with ice cream**
With 19.000 expert ice cream colleagues and iconic brands like Wall’s, Cornetto and Ben & Jerry’s, loved in 76 countries, we are the world’s largest Ice Cream company leading the industry.
  
  
We create iconic ice cream brands that are part of everyday life, bringing moments of joy to millions of people around the world. Everybody loves ice cream. And as the world’s biggest pure‑play ice cream company, we have the scale and ambition to make a real difference.
  
  
**What Truly Sets Us Apart Is How We Work.**
We move fast and keep things simple. We turn ideas into action, trust people to take ownership, and work as one team to win together with integrity. Our culture is high‑performance, collaborative and focused on getting things done.
  
  
We’re curious and ready for what’s next. We embrace digital, use data to make better decisions, and keep learning, including how AI can help us work smarter and serve consumers better.
  
  
The role
  
  
As a Finance Junior Manager gives support to the (alternatively) Materials / Factory / Logistics / Supply Chain Overheads and Business Waste respective teams by performing various day to day operational activities for them, discussing, and sharing relevant information and assumptions behind these activities so that European finance teams and countries can concentrate on their core business partnering tasks.
  
  
What you'll be responsible for
  
  
Ensure Knowledge transfer is OTIF from old SCFS Teams in Unilever ahead of the end of the TSA (Temporary Service Agreement) by end 2026.
  
  
Act as first point of contact for the respective Cost Bucket Owners in Europe and all its countries and factories covering localization process of Opus Design (New SAP) representing EU processes,
  
  
Being the linking pin between the internal Cost Buckets Owners and the team members in charge of transfer pricing and intercompany flows
  
  
Coordinate the Business Plan & Quarterly TP update processes between GBS team and 3rd party subcontractors where applicable
  
  
Facilitate the Transfer Price corrections and strengthen the controls process identifying together with Unilever SCFS the root causes
  
  
Deliver understanding & transparency of Supply Chain cost developments (Actuals vs. Forecast) for the Cost Bucket in scope
  
  
Maintain and develop various TP reporting using relevant tools (Power BI, Power Query etc.)
  
  
Lead projects for further development of the analytical support provided to the external stakeholders
  
  
Lead projects for continuous improvement in team processes
  
  
We're looking for someone who
  
  
University degree in Finance (minimum Bachelor)
  
  
Minimum of 4 years of finance working experience preferably in finance business partnering
  
  
Excellent MS Excel Skills. Power BI/ Power Query is required.
  
  
Effective Communication: Fluent in English, oral and written.
  
  
Analytical thinking, problem solving attitude.
  
  
Financial Accounting and Reporting knowledge
  
  
Effective Prioritization and Problem-solving attitude
  
  
Forward looking approach and ability to provide “what if” analysis
  
  
Multiple Stakeholders Management
  
  
IT skills – excellent level of computer literacy (incl excel & SAP)
  
  
Motivation to build up own agenda
  
  
Team working – demonstrate commitment to the team in helping to achieve goals; proactively share best practice, ideas and insights with colleagues
  
  
Agility and ability to adjust quickly to the changes
  
  
What you'll get
  
  
Alongside meaningful work and strong development, we offer a reward package that typically includes
  
  
Market-competitive pay and performance related rewards
  
  
Flexible ways of working
  
  
Support for health, wellbeing and life outside of work
  
  
Time off to rest and recharge
  
  
Ongoing learning and development opportunities
  
  
Specific benefits vary by location
  
  
**Why join us?**
This is a place for people who are passionate about ice cream and are growth obsessed - both for the business and for themselves. People who act like an owner and drive our business end-to-end. People who are driven by success to deliver more than we ever thought we could!
  
  
You’ll thrive here if you value an inclusive culture, with low ego and hierarchy - and if you’re excited to continuously learn and challenge how we work, using digital, data, and new thinking to push us forward.
  
  

* Roles with real accountability and visible impact
* Free to move fast, experiment and challenge how things are done
* Continuous learning and development as the business grows
* Reward linked to performance and contribution.

Your career here is shaped by what you deliver, as you work across functions and markets and grow with the business.
  
  
**Ready to build the future of Ice Cream?**
If this sounds like the place where you'd thrive, we'd love to hear from you. Apply online and share your CV. We'll review your application and be in touch with the next steps.
  
  
If you are an individual with a disability and require assistance at any time during our recruitment process, please let your Talent Acquisition Partner know.
  
  
**Additional Information**
The Magnum Ice Cream Company is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We embrace diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment where everyone can do their best work regardless of age, disability, gender identity, race, religion, sexual orientation, or any other protected characteristic.

title: Team Lead - AI & Data Science
description:
**Designation : Team Lead - AI & Data Science**

**Required Experience:**

5-6 years overall with AI/ML, data science or applied AI; at least 5 years of hands-on AI/ML/data-science work and 2+ years of technical/team leadership.

**Job Description:**

Aventior is looking for a hands-on Team Lead - AI & Data Science to lead customer-facing AI and analytics engagements from discovery through production and ongoing improvement.

The role combines technical direction, people leadership, customer communication and delivery ownership. You will turn business problems into clear requirements, assess feasibility and data readiness, shape pragmatic AI/GenAI solutions, guide engineers and data scientists, and deliver secure, measurable outcomes in production.

The strongest candidate is equally comfortable discussing business value with a customer, explaining technical options and trade-offs, reviewing code or model quality, and managing scope, risks and delivery commitments.

**Key Responsibilities**

:

**1. Customer engagement, discovery and requirement gathering -**

●Lead customer and stakeholder discovery sessions, interviews and workshops to understand business goals, users, existing workflows, pain points, data sources, constraints and success criteria.

●Translate business needs into clear problem statements, functional and non-functional requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria, assumptions, dependencies and measurable KPIs.

● Assess data availability, data quality, integration constraints, privacy/security requirements and technical feasibility before recommending an approach.

● Present solution options and trade-offs in business-friendly language, including build-versus-buy, model selection, expected value, risks, cost, latency and operational implications.

● Lead proof-of-concept planning, demos, review meetings and customer sign-off; manage clarifications, scope changes, priorities and expectation setting throughout the engagement.

**2. AI solution architecture and technical leadership-**

● Own solution design across data ingestion and preparation, model or LLM selection, retrieval, orchestration, APIs, integrations, cloud infrastructure and operational monitoring.

● Choose fit-for-purpose approaches for the business problem rather than defaulting to a particular model, vendor, framework or architecture pattern.

● Establish engineering standards through design reviews, code reviews, testing practices, reusable components, documentation and secure development practices.

● Remain hands-on for critical design decisions, prototypes, complex debugging and performance/cost optimisation while enabling the team to execute independently.

**3. Generative AI, LLMs, RAG and agentic workflows-**

● Design and deliver LLM-powered applications using commercial APIs and/or managed or open models; apply prompt design, structured outputs, tool/function calling and workflow orchestration as appropriate.

● Build and improve RAG pipelines, including document ingestion, chunking, embeddings, vector or hybrid retrieval, reranking, access-aware retrieval, source attribution and grounded answer generation.

● Select and apply agentic patterns only where they add value; define tool permissions, bounded actions, state transitions, approval steps, retries and safe failure behavior.

● Create systematic evaluation approaches for task success, groundedness, retrieval relevance, factuality, safety and user experience; use representative test sets, regression tests and human review where needed.

●Improve quality, latency and cost through retrieval/model comparisons, prompt and context tuning, caching, routing, token-usage controls and production feedback loops.

**4. Applied machine learning and data science-**

● Guide the framing, development and validation of appropriate ML/statistical solutions such as classification, regression, forecasting, anomaly detection, clustering, NLP or optimization.

● Establish baselines and evaluation criteria; interpret results, investigate failure modes, check for data leakage and communicate limitations and confidence clearly.

● Partner with data engineers and analysts on data profiling, feature engineering, data pipelines, dataset quality, reproducibility and reliable access to data.

● Guide specialist computer-vision, OCR/intelligent document processing or multimodal work when required by the project portfolio; deep specialist research methods are not a blanket requirement for this role.

**5. Production engineering, cloud and MLOps / LLMOps-**

●Build or guide production services and integrations using Python and REST APIs (FastAPI or equivalent), with appropriate validation, authentication, error handling, testing and documentation.

●Deploy and operate solutions in AWS or the agreed cloud platform. Relevant AWS services may include S3, SageMaker, Bedrock, RDS, Glue, EventBridge, Redshift, Lambda and container/orchestration services, depending on the architecture.

●Implement or oversee CI/CD, containerization, environment management, model/prompt/version tracking, automated tests, release controls, rollback and operational handover.

●Monitor application health and business/model quality, including latency, throughput, availability, cost, token consumption, retrieval quality, feedback signals and model/data drift where applicable.

● Own incident triage and root-cause analysis with engineering/platform teams; define fallback paths and support processes for customer-facing AI capabilities.

**6. Delivery management and stakeholder alignment-**

●Own the delivery plan from discovery to launch: estimates, milestones, sprint/backlog priorities, resource needs, dependencies, risks, testing, UAT, release readiness and transition to support.

●Maintain a clear decision, action and risk log; provide concise progress updates; escalate issues early and propose options instead of only reporting blockers.

●Coordinate across customer teams, product/business analysts, data engineering, software engineering, QA, cloud/DevOps, security and domain experts.

●Ensure acceptance criteria and agreed business outcomes are met, and capture lessons learned and post-launch improvements

**7. Team leadership, governance and responsible AI-**

● Coach and mentor AI engineers and data scientists; support work allocation, technical growth, feedback, code/model reviews and consistent quality standards.

●Apply appropriate data governance, privacy, access control, PII handling, audit logging, human review and responsible-AI safeguards based on use-case risk.

●Identify GenAI-specific risks such as prompt injection, insecure tool access, unintended data exposure, unsupported outputs and misuse; document mitigations and residual risks.

●Build reusable patterns, documentation and team practices that improve delivery predictability across multiple customer engagements

**Required Qualifications and experience:**

●5-6 years of relevant software engineering, AI/ML, data science or applied                        

AI experience, including at least 5 years of hands-on delivery experience.

●At least 2 years leading a technical team, delivery workstream or project; demonstrated ownership of technical decisions and outcomes.

●At least 2 years in customer-facing or stakeholder-facing delivery, with evidence of running discovery workshops, clarifying requirements, presenting options and managing expectations.

●Strong Python engineering and practical SQL/data skills; understanding of testing, APIs, code quality and software engineering fundamentals.

Full time or part time

Vessel Performance, Predictive Diagnostics, Predictive Maintenance, Condition Based Monitoring (CBM)

Sailed as Chief Engineer (Marine) plus mandatory shore experience in vessel performance, Condition based monitoring, Predictive machinery health
  
  
**Purpose and Scope of the Role**
The Vessel Performance Expert is SSH’s domain authority on how ships actually run. The role links onboard engineering reality with SSH’s digital platform, so that performance insights, diagnostics and maintenance recommendations are technically credible to Chief Engineers, superintendents, ship owners & managers.
  
  
The scope covers fleet-wide monitoring of main engine, auxiliary engine, machinery performance and hull, propulsion, supports both customer-facing delivery and the product and data science teams building SSH’s analytics.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Predictive Diagnostics**

* Detect early deviations in main engine, auxiliary engine, turbocharger, boiler and auxiliary machinery behaviour, and identify probable root causes.
* Define diagnostic rules, thresholds and fault signatures with the data science team; validate model alerts against engineering judgement.

**Predictive Maintenance**

* Translate diagnostic findings into maintenance recommendations, spares planning and risk-ranked work orders.
* Align recommendations with PMS, class requirements and OEM guidelines; track outcomes to improve model accuracy.

**Condition Based Monitoring (CBM)**

* Design and maintain CBM programmes covering vibration, lube oil analysis, exhaust gas temperatures, cylinder pressures and bearing temperatures.
* Define sensor and data requirements for new vessels and retrofits; review data quality and flag gaps.

**Vessel Performance**

* Analyse speed, fuel consumption, trim, draft, hull and propeller condition, and weather-corrected performance using noon, high-frequency sensor and voyage data.
* Benchmark vessels and sister ships; recommend operational and technical actions that cut fuel cost and emissions (CII, EEOI, EU ETS exposure).
* Quantify hull cleaning, dry-dock and retrofit impact; produce performance reports for owners, managers and charterers.

**Customer and Internal Collaboration**

* Act as technical interface with customers’ superintendents and Chief Engineers; support presales demos and onboarding.
* Provide domain input to Product and Engineering for features, dashboards and alert logic.
* Mentor junior analysts on marine engineering concepts.

**Required Qualifications And Experience**

* Sailed as Chief Engineer (Marine) on ocean-going vessels; valid CoC Class I (Motor/Steam) or equivalent.
* Shore-side experience in vessel performance is a must (for example in vessel or fleet performance management, performance analytics or technical superintendency with a performance focus).
* Demonstrated hands-on expertise in vessel performance, condition based monitoring, predictive diagnostics and predictive maintenance.
* Degree in Marine or Mechanical Engineering.

**Preferred**

* Experience with performance or CBM platforms, noon-report and high-frequency data, and OEM monitoring systems.
* Working knowledge of IMO CII, SEEMP, EU ETS and FuelEU Maritime.
* Exposure to Python, SQL or BI tools for analysis.
* Experience working with data science or product teams or customer-facing exposure.

**Deliverables, Engagement Terms and Why SSH**
**Key deliverables and KPIs**

* Monthly fleet performance and CBM reports delivered on time.
* Diagnostic alerts validated with a documented root cause and recommended action.
* Maintenance recommendations accepted and closed by customers; targets to be agreed with the hiring manager.
* Documented diagnostic rules and CBM playbooks added to SSH’s knowledge base.

**Why join Smart Ship Hub**

* Apply sea-going experience to a global maritime digital platform.
* Shape predictive analytics products used by ship owners and managers.
* Work directly with leadership in a growth-stage environment.

**About the Organisation & Role:**
You will be part of the Core Commerce Platform organisation responsible for delivering the omnichannel commerce capabilities that power the purchase journey, inventory availability, delivery promise, order processing & fulfilment and post-purchase experiences across channels. The organisation plays a critical role in ensuring products are available to buy, orders can be fulfilled reliably, and commitments made to consumers are delivered consistently. As a Software Engineer, you will build the backend services that power omnichannel commerce capabilities. You will be responsible for technical design, implementation and validation. * Develop production-grade microservices using Java and Spring Boot, with a strong focus on scalability, resilience, maintainability, and operational performance.
